# Pedagogical Theory Corpus

## Document: Instructional Design & Cognitive Scaffolding
SourceID: src_pedagogy_001
Authority: HIGH
Domain: education

### Section: Constructivist Scaffolding and ZPD
Instructional scaffolding is a temporary supportive structure provided by educators or materials to enable learners to accomplish tasks within their Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD).
Scaffolding fading refers to the gradual withdrawal of instructional prompts, hints, and intermediate steps as the learner develops autonomous competence.
Concrete-to-abstract sequencing grounds novel formal concepts in intuitive physical phenomena before presenting formal mathematical models.
Worked examples reduce extraneous cognitive load during initial schema acquisition in novice learners.
